title: ansi_term is no longer maintained
summary: The maintainer has advised that ansi_term is deprecated and will not receive any maintenance.
replacement: A maintained terminal-styling crate (the advisory lists unvetted alternatives such as anstyle, nu-ansi-term, owo-colors, and console)

constraints: Keep the same colors and styles in terminal output.

steps.title: Replace ansi_term
steps.instructions: Replace ansi_term with a maintained styling crate (the advisory lists anstyle, nu-ansi-term, owo-colors, and console as unvetted options) and update `Style`, `Colour`, and `ANSIString` uses.

verification.purpose: Build and test after the styling change.
